Mack-8 Armory is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. Their logo is their name MACK8 in all caps above an inverted equilateral triangle with the word ARMORY placed within the line of the inverted triangle's base.

The Marathon Pad is a set of Stock attachments for Sniper Rifles, the EM2 assault rifle, and the Hauer 77 shotgun in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. There are three forms of the Marathon Pad, two having the same affect of improving the sprint recovery time but with some having the downside of a decreased hip fire accuracy. The third is exclusive to the Hauer 77, increasing movement speed while sprinting, shooting, and aiming, as well as decreasing sprint-to-fire delay, but at the cost of a decreased hip fire accuracy.

The is a battle rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

Test Subjects are found aboard the MSV Fedele. Apart from Dr. Heart they are the only beings aboard. The Test Subjects are beings who have been horribly mutated by experiments performed on them by the salarian Dr. Saleon, masquerading under the pseudonym Dr. Heart. They presumably contain grown organs for the doctor to harvest, similar to his criminal organisation on the Citadel. On obtaining Saleon's whereabouts from Garrus, Shepard has the option of putting these creatures down along the way to the doctor's location in the ship.
Weyrloc Clanguards are krogan warriors in the service of Clan Weyrloc on Tuchanka. They appear in the mission Mordin: Old Blood.
Barbados F7 was a Mechanical Beast that was sent to battle Devilman under the sea in Mazinger Z vs. Devilman alongside a demon named [https://devilman.fandom.com/wiki/Bugo Bugo].
The is a marksman rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.
Deathtokiller G7 was a small human sized Mechanical Beast from the Mazinger TV Comic.
Dagora was an manta ray-like Aquatic Warrior Beast who appeared in episode 21 of Great Mazinger.

Gemini were a pair of African cyborgs. They wore shades on their mostly cybernetic heads, and typically wore black suits. They acted as the bodyguards for the African Prime Minister N'mani, although both ended up significantly injured by Sundowner, one of which was via decapitation via the shears form of his Bloodlust set of machetes. They were shown to be very skilled in combat, as evidenced by their taking down several Desperado cyborgs while defending N'mani's limousine with minimum effort shortly before Metal Gear RAY arrived. Both survived the attack.
The Mangler Cannon is a craftable support featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies.

Mark Cortez was a former FOXHOUND member who later served as the commander of the Esteria Army Special Forces under the rank of Colonel. Cortez served FOXHOUND during Big Boss's term as commanding officer alongside Roy Campbell for years prior to the Outer Heaven Uprising. An expert in psychological warfare, Cortez was awarded the codename of Falcon for completing over 10000 hours of one-man on-site procurement missions. However, he became disillusioned with the U.S. military during an operation, when he, Campbell, and a third man named John, were stranded in the middle of a battlefield and were denied assistance for evacuation. While Campbell and Cortez escaped, John did not and died due to a fatal wound. After leaving FOXHOUND, Cortez became a naturalized citizen of the South American country of Esteria, where he became the commanding officer of the Esteria Army Special Forces. Ten years after his departure from FOXHOUND, Cortez secretly conspired with SVR operative Sergei Ivanovich and his men to stage a coup d'état against the local government. When Roy Campbell was ordered by the White House to work with the Esteria Army Special Forces to repel Ivanovich's men, Cortez used his position within the EASF to have Ivanovich's men capture Campbell in a planned ambush and placed him under house arrest. However, Cortez was unaware that Ivanovich's true motive was to draw in and eliminating the surviving members of FOXHOUND from the Shadow Moses Incident (Campbell, Meryl Silverbu

Skowronski was a loyal colonel of the Red Army and a former fighter pilot during World War II. He served as the commanding officer of the secret Soviet missile base on the San Hieronymo Peninsula, prior to FOX's armed takeover in 1970.

Trenya is a Felyne, an intelligent creature that looks like a very large cat. Hailing from Pokke Farm, he is also an adventurous treasure hunter, who travels to various regions in his boat. During his adventures, Trenya took Naked Snake from the mainland of Costa Rica to Isla del Monstruo to hunt for monsters. At least one MSF soldier managed to briefly encounter Trenya near the Carribbean coast, and ended up telling his commander, Big Boss, to investigate if he got the opportunity. Trenya appeared before Naked Snake in his boat at Playa del Alba, during the Peace Walker Incident in 1974. Snake instinctively pointed his gun at the enigmatic creature, then was further surprised when the cat-like animal spoke to him. Trenya asked if Snake happened to be a hunter, due to his "killer eyes," and introduced himself. He explained that if Snake was a hunter, he could take him to an island inhabited by rare creatures, thinking that Snake would "get a kick out of hunting them." Snake was surprised to learn that there were apparently creatures rarer than a talking cat, to which Trenya responded that these creatures were even bigger and were "real monsters." Trenya was disappointed to learn that Snake was not a hunter, as he had travelled all the way from Pokke Farm only to have no customers for his Monster Hunting sale thus far. Maisel is a weapon manufacturer featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
The gryphon is Zeus' winged mount appearing in Poseidon's Last Play in Minecraft Mini-Series.

A piglin brute is a hostile and stronger variant of the piglin. It wields a golden axe and appears in all types of bastion remnants. Unlike piglins, piglin brutes do not barter, retreat, or get distracted by gold.

A snow golem is a buildable passive mob that throws snowballs at monsters, which provokes them to attack it. Depending on the biome temperature, it also either produces a trail of snow or takes heat damage and dies.
The MXR-17 is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

A shulker is a cubic hostile mob found only in End cities. It hides in its shell to protect itself and blend in with its surroundings, and attacks by shooting homing bullets that inflict Levitation. It is the only source of shulker shells, which are used to craft shulker boxes.

Tiny Vu is a miniaturized doppelgänger of Vu Bui, who typically appeared during Community Votes. Although similar in personality and appearance to "Giant Vu," Tiny Vu was shown consistently to be a separate entity with many secrets.
Tiny Lydia is a miniaturized doppelgänger of Lydia Winters, who appeared in the 2023 Mob Vote Event.
The MPC-25 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
A vindicator is an illager armed with an iron axe. Vindicators spawn in woodland mansions and participate in raids. They sprint toward their targets to attack them with their axe.

The stronger and faster the attack, the greater the damage that will be done to the attacker. If the attacker is able to avoid taking any significant damage, Kimimaro can keep the bones protruding from his body, thereby discouraging any additional attacks. If the opponent attacks anyway, the bones can be used to absorb the blow and then capture the attacking arm or leg, leaving them at Kimimaro's mercy.

The [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Messerschmitt_Me_323 Messerschmitt Me 323] "Gigant" was a transport aircraft, used in World War II. It was used to carry large amounts of equipment such as tanks and artillery.

Shizune wears a device on her forearm that's loaded with five senbon. While contained within the device, the senbon are immersed in a poison potent enough to leave victims near-death from a mere scratch. The device is fired by pulling an attached string, which quickly shoots the five senbon at any target Shizune aims at. Because of how the device is configured, the senbon cannot be fired individually. However, by channeling her chakra into the string, Shizune can alter the trajectory of the senbon, either to concentrate them on one point, spread them over a larger area, or even change the direction of the senbon from what the device is aimed at. Shizune generally uses this as a surprise attack, as the device is hidden by her sleeve, is not bulky enough to be noticed, and furthermore she does not give the impression of being able to fight, thus lowering an opponent's guard.

The snakes can also be used to enter areas that they might find difficult to access otherwise. The user can then manipulate its actions, when given the command.

Gun Ranger Finder 1st Class Mitchell was a member of the U.S. Navy who abandoned his damaged and possibly sinking vessel during a surprise attack by Japanese PT Boats and A6M Zeros. He can either be rescued by PO Locke, or he can be killed by enemy fire while swimming. If rescued, he will get into a bunk in the crew quarters in Locke's PBY Catalina.

Kidōmaru spits a thick rope of webbing from his mouth at a target. The rope is very sticky because of all the webs that are layered together, which Kidōmaru can further increase (or decrease) the stickiness of by altering how much chakra flows into the rope. The rope attaches firmly to targets at the point of contact, allowing Kidōmaru to fling them around into the surroundings. Alternatively, the rope itself can be used to damage targets directly as a whip.
Kidōmaru spews rope made of webs, which he uses to swing around the area.
Dosu grabs the opponent by the throat, releasing a small amount of sound from his device, disorienting them.

The Mikoyan MiG-29 "Fulcrum" is a Russian fighter jet used by the Ultranationalists and OpFor in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Ghosts.

The user expels high viscosity water to cover the ground. This stream of sticky liquid can be used to form an adhesive trap that will inhibit a person's mobility. One can effectively reduce their enemy's area of activity with this technique, giving the user an advantage on the battlefield. The normal scope of this technique is normally just a few metres, but it is possible to make an entire pond of starch syrup. The syrup can be manipulated to move after it is created, being able to stick and travel up surfaces.

An extremely versatile move, this technique uses chakra to activate the roots in the ground and, using the user of the technique as a reference point, makes wooden pillars appear from left and right. The wooden pillars join together in a dome-shape with the user at the centre. In the case that the user confronts the enemy at a short distance, the enemy can be locked up inside the dome, catching the enemy in a double sided attack. Furthermore, it can function as an easy shelter against an enemy's long-distance attacks, like the shockwave created from Naruto Uzumaki in his Version 2 state.

Birdy is a Sea King. It is one of the six Sea Kings that speak to Shirahoshi when she fully manifests the power of Poseidon.
The Basilisk is the second-in-command of Impel Down's Level 2: Beast Hell, under the Sphinx. It is a snake born from a chicken as a result of a rare mutation.

Buggy the Star Clown is the nominal president of Cross Guild, and one of the current Four Emperors dominating the New World. Initially a Roger Pirates apprentice alongside Shanks, Buggy succeeded his disbanded mentors as a career pirate in the East Blue, in time becoming captain of the Buggy Pirates. One of the earliest enemies defeated by Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates, revenge drove him to an alliance with "Iron Mace" Alvida and pursuit into the Grand Line. Since then, his fortunes have constantly, dramatically revolved: from imprisonment in Impel Down to entanglement in its first mass-breakout and the subsequent Summit War of Marineford, his escalating infamy won him entry to the Seven Warlords of the Sea, allowing him to launch the pirate mercenary organization Buggy's Delivery. After the Warlords were outlawed, Buggy found himself "leading" the Cross Guild, a successor group actually controlled by fellow ex-Warlords Crocodile and Dracule Mihawk; with his inflated reputation, he was grudgingly retained as figurehead leader, and gained recognition as one of the new Emperors. Emboldened, Buggy has declared his intent to become the Pirate King, putting Cross Guild in pursuit of the One Piece. He is the main antagonist of the Orange Town Arc and a secondary antagonist in the Loguetown Arc, as well as the central protagonist of the Buggy's Crew Adventure Chronicles cover arc (the manga's first). Since then, he has become one of the series' most-recurring characters,

The MiG-17 was a single-engined Russian designed fighter jet used throughout the Cold War era. It is fielded by the Soviet Air Force and was used in large numbers during the Vietnam War by the Vietnam People's Air Force. It is featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified.

Charlotte Tablet is the 21st son and 34th child of the Charlotte Family and the younger twin brother of High-Fat. He also is an officer of the Big Mom Pirates and serves as Totto Land's , governing over Topping Island.

The Great Tree is an island-sized, flora-based organism created by a now-lost civilization over a millennia ago for the purpose of electing future leaders through ordeals. An entity of immense power, she has the ability to host people's thoughts and create presents whose natures are decided according to the character of her candidates. However, she failed to live up to her purpose and was so thrown away to wander the sea, eventually coming to rest in the latter half of Paradise. In the present day, the Straw Hat Pirates came across the Great Tree and accidentally reactivated her. Promising the crew a present if they were to clear her ordeals, the Great Tree produced islands with different ordeals on them for the Straw Hat Pirates to clear and created Gaburi, a companion for the crew, to record their actions. When the Straw Hat Pirates became qualified for their present and came to claim it, the Great Tree prepared to turn Gaburi into it, only to get frighten by the evil in human nature and turn Gaburi into the Doom Guardian. Although the Straw Hats Pirates managed to escape with the original piece of Gaburi, they soon returned to the Great Tree and had Gaburi reclaim the Doom Guardian from her for his own survival while making the Great Tree come to an understanding with him about humanity. The Great Tree serves as the main antagonist of One Piece Unlimited Cruise 1: The Treasure Beneath the Waves and One Piece Unlimited Cruise 2: Awakening of a Hero.

Billy Sole was a mercenary and a member of Major "Dutch" Schaefer's private military team. In 1987, Schaefer's team was hired by the U.S. military and the CIA for a rescue mission in Val Verde. After discovering that their mission was a set-up to dupe them into eliminating the rebels in the area, Schaefer's squad came into contact with a Predator that stalked and killed the elite mercenaries one-by-one. An expert tracker, Billy was something of an outsider in the group, and became notably disturbed following the team's contact with the Predator. He died challenging the Predator in hand-to-hand combat, armed only with his combat machete.

Sergeant Blain Cooper was a mercenary and a member of Major "Dutch" Schaefer's private military team. In 1987, Schaefer's team was hired by the U.S. military and the CIA for a rescue mission in Val Verde. After discovering that their mission was a set-up to dupe them into eliminating the rebels in the area, Schaefer's squad came into contact with a Predator that stalked and killed the elite mercenaries one-by-one. Blain acted as the team's heavy hitter, notably carrying a handheld M134 Minigun during the mission in Val Verde. He had served alongside his close friend Mac Eliot for many years before they both joined Dutch's team, and the two had developed a close friendship.
Meiko Optics is a weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

The Boiler was a caste encountered by the United States Colonial Marine Corps from the on LV-426. The Boiler toted a unique form of attack, suicidally rupturing its own body and drenching nearby targets in huge quantities of acidic blood.

The Captive Predator was a captured by the billionaire Tyler Stern. Imprisoned within a biosphere, the Predator would adapt exceedingly to its new environment, eventually causing chaos in the facility after ambushing and massacring a security team. The Captive Predator was eventually subdued by Stern himself, but not before managing to activate his Self-Destruct Device and destroy the entire facility.

The Dog Queen is a that appears in the Alien3 video game released on the Super Nintendo Entertainment System. They are essentially an oversized Runner Alien, looking similar but considerably larger. They spit clouds of acid smoke and live on the surface of the planet Fiorina "Fury" 161. In the description for the mission in which they appear for the first time, it is said that they are attempting to create a new Hive outside the prison colony. The player must prevent this from happening by killing them all.
The Medic Plate Carrier is an equipment featured in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Mobile.

The "Djinn", as regarded by the locals, was a lone who resided himself deep within Eastern Afghanistan. He would partake in hunts in the region, be it against Jihadi soldiers or US personnel. Due to his slaughtering of the Jihadis, the local villagers deemed him a guardian and savior, though a young boy, Atal, had deduced that he was actually indifferent to what side he was killing. He would subsequently become the target of Jaya Soames and her team of hunters, with mercenary Tyler Swain realising that he was the same Predator who had killed his squad-mates in a previous skirmish. The Djinn would ultimately perish after Swain sacrificed himself by luring the Predator into a minefield, killing the both of them.

The Dead Men Triad were drug dealers and the three leaders of the Dead Men gang in Neonopolis in 2030. As dealers in Borgia Industries' Prometheus Tech, the Dead Men Triad found themselves the targets of the Yautja Scarface when it travelled to Neonopolis to Hunt those who had proliferated his species' equipment. These leaders used their elongated nails as claws against Scarface. They also had fangs in their teeth. Scarface defeated these leaders during his attack on their hideout. After Scarface took their heads as trophies, they were skinned and hung up in the church along with their members.

The Facehugger, known taxonomically as Manumala noxhydria and designated "Stage 1" Xenomorph by Weyland-Yutani scientists (and "Stage 2" by other sources), was a parasitoid 'prelarval' form of the species that hatched from an Ovomorph. It was the second stage in the Xenomorph's life cycle, and existed solely to orally implant a Chestburster within a living host. As such, it had no real offensive capabilities beyond an ability to spit acid, and relied on stealth, surprise or their victims being previously immobilized by an attacker to achieve implantation. The Facehugger died shortly after its task was completed.

The Merlin Mini is a Reflex Sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles, SMGs, Shotguns and Pistols.

The failed Ripley clones are the result of the United Systems Military and Dr. Mason Wren's experiments to resurrect the Xenomorph XX121 species, for use as biological weapons. Created aboard the USM Auriga, they are horrifically malformed creatures, containing aspects of both Ellen Ripley and the Xenomorph. Seven failed clones were developed before the "success" of the eighth clone, "Ripley 8". Clones 1-6 died an indeterminate time after their creation and were preserved, but Ripley 7 survived to maturity before being euthanized by Ripley 8.

Gene was a Hyperdyne Systems 341B command adjutant synthetic In 2187, Gene was charged by General Delyla Vaughn of the United States Colonial Marine Corps—and shadowy cabal Deep Void—to oversee a cargo of Biodrone s being covertly ferried to a summit on LV-846. Unable to comply due to his programming, Gene released the creatures from captivity, disabled all communications hardware and dropships on the Alexiares, and ejected all of its lifeboats.

Imbre Anguis, whose name was made by Thia, were snake-like creatures native to the planet Genna. They were capable of emitting fluid which, when combined, became acidic. These creatures, when fed, were highly capable of social interaction, overall friendliness, and even bonding with one specimen even sacrificing itself for another creature. One was used by the Dek as an organic Plasmacaster, and was nicknamed as Squirt, to defeat a number of Weyland-Yutani Corporation synthetics.

The Merlin Reflex is a reflex sight featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It is classed as a Universal Attachment and unlocking it for the weapon it is unlocked under, unlocks it for the entire weapon class. It is available for Assault Rifles, SMGs and LMGs.

Ian Whyte (born September 17, 1971) is a Welsh actor, stuntman and former professional basketball player who portrayed Scar in the 2004 film , Wolf in the 2007 film and the Last Engineer in the 2012 film . He also portrayed the Ancient Predator in Alien vs. Predator, as well as Celtic and Chopper in most shots where the three Predators did not appear on-screen together, although he was not credited for these roles. Alien vs. Predator was Whyte's first film role. Other notable films he has appeared in include Clash of the Titans (2010) and Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows — Part 1 (2010). He has also appeared as various characters in the television series Game of Thrones. Standing at the height of 7 ft 1 in. (2.16 m), Whyte has played numerous monsters in feature films.

An Infectoid is a living creature infected by unknown means to defend the s' hives. Instead of being sedated and glued to the Hive's walls, they run freely, acting in a zombie-like state and attacking nearby intruders. If a is infected, it will become insane and much more hyper-aggressive than a human Infectoid.

James George Janos (born July 15, 1951), better known by his stage name Jesse Ventura, is an American actor, author, media personality, ex-Navy SEAL, former politician and retired professional wrestler who played Blain in the 1987 film . Predator was Ventura's first film role. Other notable films Ventura has appeared in include The Running Man (1987), Demolition Man (1993) and Batman & Robin (1997). Ventura was part of the U.S. Navy Underwater Demolition Team 12 during the Vietnam War and received a Vietnam Service Medal, although he has since disclosed that he did not see combat. Following his military service, he went on to embark on a professional wrestling career lasting from 1975 to 1986. There, he claimed the ring name Jesse "The Body" Ventura. In addition, Ventura has also had a career in politics; he served as the 38th Governor of Minnesota from 1999 to 2003. On television, Ventura is perhaps best-known for hosting the show Conspiracy Theory with Jesse Ventura (2009-2012), where he and his team of investigators attempt to unravel modern-day conspiracy theories.

Mini Gundam Strike is a limited-time multiplayer game mode featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. It was added in July 2025 as part of the Season 6: Gundams Arrive update. It is based on the Gundam franchise. It is accessed via the Gundam Hub. Players take control of a mini Gundam in automated battles to help level up their equipped Gundam to unlock new suits and skills. Every battle won will progress and increase the difficulty, earning new rewards for both their Gundam and individual player to use in other modes.

Jean-Claude Camille François Van Varenberg (born October 18, 1960), known professionally as Jean-Claude Van Damme, is a Belgian martial artist, actor and director who was originally cast as the Predator in the 1987 film . He was eventually replaced by Kevin Peter Hall. Other notable films Van Damme has appeared in include Kickboxer (1989), Universal Soldier (1992), Hard Target (1993), Street Fighter (1994), JCVD (2008) and The Expendables 2 (2012). Van Damme worked for director John McTiernan for (1987) as an early (eventually abandoned) version of the titular alien, before being removed and replaced by Kevin Peter Hall.

Judith was a Hyperdyne Systems 129-4 "sex synth" serving aboard the transport vessel Incunabulum. She was serving on the ship when it unknowingly set down on a moon infested by s, leading to the death of all but one of its crew and passengers. Judith, along with the rest of the crew, was captured by the Xenomorphs and taken to their Hive. She was destroyed trying to defend her human crewmates from the creatures, which quickly overpowered her and tore her apart in response to her aggression.

The Second Acheron Queen was the second leader of a Hive on Acheron (LV-426), encountered in 2179 by a unit of Colonial Marines from the . The Queen served as the successor to the First Acheron Queen, which was killed by Ellen Ripley 17 weeks previously. She was killed when she was ejected into LV-426's upper atmosphere from the Resolute by Captain Jeremy Cruz.

Sean Fifield was a geologist who was a part of the crew of the sent to search for the origins of mankind on LV-223. Upon being separated from the rest of the crew inside the Engineer temple, Fifield was ultimately exposed to Chemical A0-3959X.91 – 15 and underwent a gruesome mutation into an Anathema. He was eventually killed after going on a rampage and attacking the crew within the ship's hanger.

The National Dynamics SunSpot "Good Boy", also referred to as the Good Boy, was a model of dog–like combat automaton developed by National Dynamics. Good Boys were deployed by a branch of the United States Colonial Marine Corps, the Midnighters, against a infestation on LV-991 in 2184.

The Siren was a type of famed for its ear-piercing screech. While it presented little threat on its own, and preferred to flee when confronted, the Siren was able to summon other Xenomorphs to its location; for that role, it preferred Bursters.

The is a German twin-engined heavy night fighter/bomber featured in Call of Duty: WWII. It was used by the Luftwaffe during World War II. The Bf 110 appears only in the multiplayer when playing as the Axis Powers when a Counter Recon Aircraft Scorestreak is called in. Once called in, the aircraft will fly in the skies and patrol, preventing Recon Planes from spawning unless one is already active in which case it will shoot it down. Its Allied equivalent is the P-61 Black Widow.

The Matriarch, also known as the "Hag Queen," was an ancient Xenomorph Queen on BG-386. The Matriarch was originally captured by the and imprisoned on BG-386, where she was used to lay Eggs so that the Predators may hunt the resultant offspring. Thousands of years later, she was discovered and captured for study by the Weyland-Yutani Corporation, but later escaped thanks to the actions of Specimen 6. She subsequently set up a Hive at the nearby Freya's Prospect colony, where she was killed by Rookie.

The Faze is an unknown alien life form that was discovered within the Drukathi Dyson Sphere-like construct that was discovered by the Founders. It is capable of repairing and modifying technology at a greater quality than humans, and was believed to have been created by the Drukathi to maintain their constructs. When the Founders utilized the Dyson Sphere's advanced technology for their benefit, the Faze continued to improve upon the faction's own technology, as it was reverse engineered from Drukathi technology. It later made its home in the engine room of the Macbeth and was left undisturbed by the Rage, who feared it would turn on them if they attempted to experiment on it.

Tyler Stern was a billionaire and founder of Stern Industries, who managed to subdue and contain a Predator within a biosphere to study. Unbeknownst to him, Stern's Predator had adapted exceedingly to its new environment, and had began testing him and his security, culminating in chaos erupting when it slaughtered a security team. Stern eventually confronted the Predator by himself, and managed to fatally wound it, but not before it activated its Self-Destruct Device, killing the both of them and destroying the entire facility.

The Medium Telescopic Sight is an optic attachment in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It is a long range sniper scope available for the DP27. The 3-Line Rifle and Gorenko Anti-Tank Rifle have this scope equipped by default. It has sister attachments in the Type 99 Mod. 2 7x Telescopic ZF41 7.0x Telescopic M38 Mod. 2 7.0x Telescopic.
An unnamed Predator Warrior was a possibly Blooded that boarded in orbit of LV-426. He was killed by Private Anderson.

Yeyinde ("brave one"), referred to by other Yautja as Dachande ("different knife"), also nicknamed "Broken Tusk" by Machiko Noguchi, was a Leader and Clan Leader. He led several young Un-blooded Yautja to Ryushi for their first Hunt against the Xenomorphs, but when their ship was accidentally destroyed by Dr. Kesar Revna and Dachande was incapacitated, the remaining students found themselves stranded and leaderless, and would go on to be led by Tichinde in an insubordinate hunt against the humans from the colony of Prosperity Wells, as well as the Xenomorphs plaguing the colony. The debacle ultimately led to Dachande siding with the humans, specifically the colony administrator Machiko Noguchi. Dachande himself survived the incident, only to succumb to wounds received fighting a Queen at the colony, dying shortly after blooding Noguchi as a worthy hunter.

Lawrence Robert "Larry" Shreve (January 11, 1941) best known as Abdullah the Butcher, and also at times The Madman from The Sudan, is a semi-retired Canadian professional wrestler known as one of the most brutal or "hardcore" professional wrestlers of all-time. He debuted in the late 1950s. The scars in his forehead are said to be a result of frequent blading. According to Mick Foley, Shreve used to put gambling chips into the deep divots in his head to entertain (or scare) people at casinos. However, New Jack claimed in his RF shoot interview that the grooves in Shreve's head were surgically implemented. An amateur martial artist, Shreve also has knowledge of judo and karate, often including this knowledge in his professional wrestling matches. This knowledge was mainly displayed by him using judo style throws, and karate chops.

Ari Romero (December 20, 1951 – December 29, 2013), was a Mexican professional wrestler who wrestled in the US, Japan, and his Native Mexico. Ari "El Rey del Tenedor" was notorious for using a fork to make his adversaries bleed in his matches. his nickname is "El rey de las Cadenas". (Spanish for "King of the bull terrier match")

Arnold Schwarzenegger (July 30, 1947) is an Austrian born American former professional bodybuilder, actor, businessman, investor, and politician. Schwarzenegger served two terms as the 38th Governor of California from 2003 until 2011. Schwarzenegger began weight training at the age of 15. He won the Mr. Universe title at age 20 and went on to win the Mr. Olympia contest seven times. Schwarzenegger has remained a prominent presence in bodybuilding and has written many books and articles on the sport. Schwarzenegger gained worldwide fame as a Hollywood action film icon. He was nicknamed the "Austrian Oak" and the "Styrian Oak" in his bodybuilding days, "Arnie" during his acting career and more recently "The Governator" (a portmanteau of "Governor" and "The Terminator" – one of his best-known movie roles).

Leon Allen White (May 14, 1955 – June 18, 2018) better known by his ring names Big Van Vader or Vader, was an American professional wrestler. White was known for his time with New Japan Pro Wrestling, World Championship Wrestling, the World Wrestling Federation and All Japan Pro Wrestling in the 1990s. A super-heavyweight wrestler capable of significant aerial maneuvers as well as power moves, he was both a face and a heel in several professional wrestling promotions. He is a thirteen time world champion, having held the WCW World Heavyweight Championship three times., CWA World Heavyweight Championship (3 times), UWA World Heavyweight Championship (1 time).

Paul Donald Wight, Jr. (February 8, 1972), is an American professional wrestler currently signed with All Elite Wrestling (AEW). In professional wrestling, Wight is a seven-time world champion, having won the WCW World Heavyweight Championship twice, the WWF/E Championship twice, the ECW World Championship once, and the World Heavyweight Championship twice, making him the first and only wrestler ever to hold all four championships. In addition to these championships, he has also won the WWE Intercontinental Championship once, the WWE United States Championship once, and WWE Hardcore Championship three times. Wight is also an 11-time tag team champion, having won the World Tag Team Championship five times (twice with The Undertaker, and once each with Kane, Chris Jericho, and The Miz), the WWE Tag Team Championship three times (once each with Chris Jericho, The Miz, and Kane), and the WCW World Tag Team Championship three times (once each with Lex Luger, Sting, and Scott Hall).

Shirley Crabtree (November 14, 1930 - December 2, 1997), better known by his ring name Big Daddy, was one of the biggest stars of British Wrestling during the 1970s and 1980s and was the main star of Joint Promotions.

Monty Kip Sopp (November 11, 1963) is an American professional wrestler. He is best known under the ring name Billy Gunn and for his eleven year long tenure in the World Wrestling Federation / Entertainment. He has also worked for Total Nonstop Action Wrestling under the ring name Kip James. In WWE, Sopp was a one time Intercontinental Champion, a two time Hardcore Champion, and the 1999 King of the Ring, but found his greatest success as a tag team wrestler, becoming an eleven-time World Tag Team Champion. WWE wrote, "Billy Gunn had it all. The 6-foot-3, 260-pound phenomenon from Austin, Texas, was a natural athlete who could bust out a dropkick with textbook precision and hoist an opponent over his head with animal-like strength. He was charismatic, too." As of 2019, Sopp is currently signed with All Elite Wrestling (AEW), under his most famous ring name Billy Gunn. He also works in AEW as a booking agent.
Mech March is the thirty-third soundtrack in the Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare (Original Game Soundtrack).

Alejandro Cruz Ortiz (May 3, 1921 - March 8, 2007) was a Mexican Luchador (professional wrestler), known worldwide as Black Shadow. Cruz's mask vs. mask match against El Santo in 1953 is generally considered one of the most important matches in the history of Lucha Libre. Cruz often teamed with Blue Demon, working as a tag team called "Los Hermanos Shadow" (the Shadow Brothers), even though the two were not related. He was nicknamed El Hombre de Goma, translated as The Elastic Man, due to his elasticity and flexibility in the ring.

Brian Christopher Button (February 2, 1984) is an American bodybuilder and professional wrestler currently signed to All Elite Wrestling (AEW) under the ring name Brian Cage. He was previously signed to World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) from 2008-2009 and Impact Wrestling, making appearances between 2012-2014 and 2018-2020. While in Impact Wrestling, Cage became a one-time Impact X Division Champion and a one-time Impact World Champion. Cage has also wrestled in promotions including Pro Wrestling Guerrilla, Lucha Underground and Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) from 2015–2016.

Brian Reid (October 2, 1991) is an American professional wrestler previously signed to WWE NXT under the name Tony Briggs from 2014-2015. Since his release in 2015, Reid wrestles by the name Brian Tannen. Debuting in 2012, Reid continues to improve his performance in the ring. As a 6-foot-2, 275-pound wrestler, Reid is noted for his incredible physical strength as he squat-lifts over 700 pounds and can bench press 600 pounds.

The Mosin-Nagant is a Russian bolt-action rifle featured in Call of Duty, Call of Duty: United Offensive, Call of Duty: Finest Hour, Call of Duty 2, Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, as well as appearing in a flashback mission in Call of Duty: Black Ops.

Frank Donald Goodish (June 18, 1946 – July 17, 1988) was an American professional wrestler who earned his greatest fame under the ring names King Kong Brody and Bruiser Brody. Goodish was an All-State football and basketball player at Warren High School, Michigan, and played football at West Texas A&M University (then known as West Texas State) and with the Washington Redskins in the NFL. As a wrestler, he helped innovate the "brawling" style and was infamous for his wild and legitimately uncooperative demeanor.

Bronko Sandor Lupsity (December 25, 1925–August 11, 2007) was a Hungarian-born Canadian professional wrestler, manager, referee and promoter. Known by his ring names Bronco or Bronko Lubich, he and Aldo Bogni were veteran "heels" under manager "Colonel" Homer O'Dell competing in regional territories for the National Wrestling Alliance throughout Canada, the Pacific Northwest, Midwest and Southeastern United States throughout the 1960s. He and Bogni were particularly active in the Charlotte-area where they feuded with "The Flying Scotts" (George and Sandy Scott). They also had memorable feuds with George Becker and Johnny Weaver, Rip Hawk and Swede Hanson, Lars and Ole Anderson and Mr. Wrestling and Sam Steamboat. Lubich also appeared as both a wrestler and manager in Texas during the early 1960s, most notably as the manager and cornerman of then NWA United States Heavyweight Champion Angelo Poffo from 1961 to 1964, and was often known to use his cane as a foreign object to help his men score victories. It was in this role that he became a well-known booker and promoter in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. He spent his last year as an active wrestler in Texas teaming with Chris Markoff where the two feuded with Mr. Wrestling and George Scott, and Johnny Valentine and Wahoo McDaniel. Dave Johnson is an American powerlifter, bodybuilder and professional wrestler working by the ring name Broderick Shaw.

Staff Sergeant Munsey is a character that is one of the leaders of Bravo Team, and appears alongside Bravo Nine and LCpl Farrand Jr. (who is shot and killed almost instantly, depending on player action) in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS) in "Bunker Buster". During the mission, he was killed by Ultranationalists. It is, however, possible for Munsey to survive, though it is fairly difficult. Bravo 9 has to rush ahead after clearing the first room, leaving the second group of defenders. He must only kill those in the next group that pose a serious threat. Then he has to cook a grenade and throw it at the Ultranationalist armed with a shotgun in the office and finish the survivors. Lastly, Bravo 9 has to take cover and pick off the next group of enemies and link up with the reinforcements. If done correctly, Munsey will simply stay where he was.

Bruno Leopoldo Francesco Sammartino (October 6, 1935 - April 18, 2018), was an Italian professional wrestler, best known for being the longest-running champion of the World Wide Wrestling Federation (WWWF), holding the WWWF Championship across two reigns for over 12 years in total. "The Italian Strongman" has often been called "The Living Legend" of professional wrestling and is considered one of the greatest performers professional wrestling has ever known. Sammartino's actual wrestling ability was somewhat limited compared to "real" pro wrestlers like Lou Thesz, but his brawling style, power moves, and personal charisma, plus the fact that he came across as a genuinely nice guy, won him many fans, especially on the East Coast. During his career, Bruno was also known as "The Original Italian Stallion."

Jesús Luna Pozos (February 18, 1975) is a Mexican luchador (professional wrestler) who is best known in under the ring name Charly Manson (sometimes spelled Charlie Manson). In 2001 Manson suffered a career-threatening, near-fatal injury that required surgical steel to be inserted into his body. In 2008 Manson suffered an injury to the same region once more, bending the surgical steel. Pozos worked for Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) for over 10 years and was part of such groups as Los Vatos Locos, The Black Family and Los Hell Brothers. Manson left AAA in late 2009 in a public falling out with the AAA management and began working on the Mexican independent circuit and for Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) as part of Los Invasores. However, in December 2010 he made surprise jump back to AAA. In February 2012, Pozos was sentenced to 15 years in prison for assaulting two police officers the previous year.

Carlos Ray "Chuck" Norris (March 10, 1940 - March 19, 2026) was an American martial artist, actor, film producer and screenwriter. After serving in the United States Air Force, he competed as a martial artist who won many championships, and has since founded his own school of fighting, Chun Kuk Do.

Cody Garrett Runnels (June 30, 1985) is an American professional wrestler currently signed to World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). He was previously signed to All Elite Wrestling (AEW) as a talent, producer and Executive Vice President. He performs under the ring name Cody Rhodes. He is the son of late WWE Hall of Famer Dusty Rhodes and the half-brother of Goldust. After an amateur wrestling career that resulted in becoming a two-time Georgia state champion, he followed his father and older brother's footsteps into the professional ranks and joined WWE. After becoming a Triple Crown Champion in Ohio Valley Wrestling (OVW), WWE's developmental territory at the time, he was elevated to the main roster, where he became a two-time Intercontinental Champion. A prolific tag team wrestler, Rhodes has won six tag team championships (three World Tag Team Championships and three WWE Tag Team Championships) with four separate tag team partners. Along with Goldust, he also won the 2013 Tag Team of the Year Slammy Award. Runnels left WWE after requesting in May 2016.

Dan McLeod (14 June 1861 - 20 June 1958) was the ring name of a Canadian catch wrestler of the late nineteenth and early twentieth century, who held the American Heavyweight Championship twice. Born George Little in Hamilton, Ontario, he worked as a miner in Nanaimo, British Columbia and wrestled his first match in 1889, winning the Pacific Coast heavyweight championship that same year. His fanciful public profile claimed that he was born Dan S. McLeod in the Scottish Highlands in 1867. On October 26, 1897, McLeod defeated Martin Burns to win the American Heavyweight Championship, which he would retain for four years. The most notable incident during his reign as champion came far away from the media spotlight when on June 18, 1899, McLeod met and defeated a young Frank Gotch in a hard-fought impromptu match on a cinder track. It was Gotch's very first professional match and he later recounted that McLeod had hustled all involved by pretending to be a simple furniture dealer from a neighboring town, but was sufficiently impressed by Gotch's talent to leave him a visiting card revealing his true identity. McLeod's reign as champion came to an end on November 7, 1901 when he was defeated by Tom Jenkins. Amid a series of rematches between the two men, McLeod recaptured the title on Christmas Day 1902 but lost it back to Jenkins the following April. After retirement, McLeod worked as a wrestling instructor at the Los Angeles Athletic Club.

Dara Singh (November 19, 1928 – July 12, 2012) was an Indian professional wrestler, actor and politician. He started acting in 1952 and was the first sportsman to be nominated to the Rajya Sabha (upper house) of India. He worked as a Hindi and Punjabi film producer, director and writer, and he acted in films and television. He is known for his role of Hanuman in the film Bajrangi (1976) and in Ramanand Sagar's Ramayan.

Devon Starke was a terran ghost (#25876) working for Dominion Heir Apparent Valerian Mengsk. Short and slight with thinning brown hair, Starke had an unremarkable narrow face—an asset in his profession. His deep musical baritone voice draws attention, however, so he was generally silent.

Deke Cavez is a lieutenant in Raynor's Raiders. He was promoted on the battlefield of Char when Jim Raynor traveled there, intending to rescue Sarah Kerrigan from the zerg. Deke Cavez is young, tall and slight, and "fast enough to run down a hoverbike on foot". His uncle taught him how to hunt. A good leader, Cavez's youth and inexperience has sometimes caused him to make mistakes during combat. He is also afraid of the protoss.

Dorris was a terran who lived on Tarsonis, employed as a servant of the Terra Family. It was an affiliation that got her killed, caught up in a terrorist raid on the family. However, she died along with her attackers, courtesy of an unregistered telepath, her last thoughts centered on why Marco, a fellow servant, never talked to her.
Mo' Money is a gun perk featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, and a weapon perk in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Dennis "Dizz" Halkman (possibly a false name) is a terran reaper. He possesses a short and thin stature, with a strong grip and an "aw, shucks" demeanor.

Edullon, the daughter of Demioch, was a protoss zealot. Aged 103, she was renowned for her ability but missed promotion unfairly. She and Syndrea are the first female protoss characters portrayed in the series, preceding Raszagal in Brood War.

Geoffrey was a terran who served the anti-Confederate rebel/terrorist Cliff Nadaner. He took part in a raid against the Terra Family, although he was terrified that he'd be caught and thrown in jail; a concept that frightened him to his core (his fear of jail stemmed from his claustrophobia). It was not imprisonment but death that greeted Geoffrey however, due to one of the family member's psionic powers.

The Modular Atomic Disintegrator is a wonder weapon featured in the Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare Zombies map Attack of the Radioactive Thing. It shoots extremely powerful atomic blasts at zombies. It can only be obtained through the Magic Wheel and can only be upgraded with parts found around the map. The Weapon's charged shot can kill a Crog Brute with one hit while potentially wiping out a zombie horde. Its normal shots can trigger the Change Chews effects, increasing its power. Completing the MAD for the first time earns the MAD Proto Achievement/Trophy.

The "Ghost Brother" was a Confederate ghost assigned to wipe out a cult, the Church of Besainted Pelagius. He succeeded in killing several high-ranking members before Pelagius used an invention to catch it. Pelagius used his neural inhibitor to control it, and used the same technology to control other cultists as well. Years later, a Kel-Morian salvage team arrived on the planet, the Ghost Brother beginning the same kind of work he'd done when he was loyal to the Confederacy. The team's two combat members were killed while he managed to capture the team's engineer. The last surviving member, a technical specialist, tried to escape, the Ghost Brother in pursuit. At the last second he drew off, only to enter the team's salvage vessel and set it on a course away from the planet, ensuring that the Combine would not come to the planet for its missing team.

Four is a spectre, and was a part of Emperor Arcturus Mengsk's attempts to revive Project Shadowblade. Four is pale skinned and has blonde hair cut close to his head. He often smiled, but never with a friendly expression. As he lacked a proper name, it was one given by terran reporter Donny Vermillion in order to tell the spectres apart.

"Guns" was the name for a terran ghost coined by Nova Terra and Malcolm Kelerchian. He was a sharpshooter and weapons expert, hence the nickname. In 2503, he was one of a number of ghosts assigned to the pair as part of the counter-insurgency against Project Shadowblade. Alongside them, he was dispatched to Altara, the team assembling entirely on the Palatine a few days later. Later, Guns was assigned to the team to defend Arcturus Mengsk from a spectre uprising. However, the group were attacked by spectres and swiftly overwhelmed. The ghosts managed to hold the palace and prevent the Emperor's assassination, but at great cost; all but two ghosts had been killed, and those two had been captured and indoctrinated into the spectre program. It is unknown if Guns was killed or indoctrinated.
Staff Sergeant Murphy is a character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is a squad leader of the Charlie Company which Davis ordered the platoon to rescue.

Captain Jack Larimer, frequently known as "Captain Jack", was the commander of a Tactical Response Squad during the Guild Wars. Larimer had the whipcord-thin build of a runner, a pastime that he both enjoyed and excelled at. He was very sure of himself had much self-confidence and in the mind of Tychus Findlay, "mean as hell."

Jack is a terran criminal and former second in command of the Screaming Skulls in the 2490s, under Declan Moore. He is a large, well muscled black man. He has an admiration of the brutality of Alli, his associate in the skulls, and has a cheerful demeanor. Jack met with Tychus Findlay and Jim Raynor when they and the Screaming Skulls exchanged a shipment of crystals. Jack verified that the shipment was actually there. Afterward, the group went aboard the Privateer and continued to drink in it.
Kath Toom a.k.a. Agent X52735N was a terran ghost turned spectre.

The karak is a type of critter. It comes in male and female forms. The males of the species have plumage to attract females of the species, while females have much less impressive plumage. Karaks are/were found on Shakuras, Zhakul, Monlyth, Typhon XI Valhalla, Aiur, and Calus, home to a leaping form which can attack enemies. Karak eggs are used on terran worlds as an alternative to chicken eggs for culinary purposes, but are largely viewed as inferior. Karaks themselves are also consumed.
James Fortune was a Kel-Morian mining baron. He was assassinated by ghost Horvald Winston.
Lila is a low-level terran telepath. She has large eyes and coltish legs.

He is a hard-talking and hard-fighting man who always gets the bad guy, constantly fighting corrupt officials. He was a favorite character of Arcturus Mengsk during his youth.

Lantharis is a phase-smith and former member of the Khalai Caste, who resented the loss of the Khala after the End War. She was unusually tall and had pale skin, and a strong resentment toward the Nerazim. At some point she had some basic combat training.
